summary: This bill establishes a Venezuela Restoration Fund in the U.S. Treasury, directing that assets forfeited from individuals or entities associated with the Chávez or Maduro regimes be deposited into it, and makes these funds available to the Secretary of State to support democratic governance, human rights, independent media, and anti-corruption efforts in Venezuela.
